items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Because he used to come twice a week for lessons. Yeah. And we were living on St. Philip Street that day.

ctx.x: Did he bring his clarinet, too, or was it mostly for reading, or to learn the instrument?

He was to learn, uh, I think it was for the reading. Uh-huh. To analyze the music, you know? Uh-huh. I think that's what it was. I know he taught him. Yeah. Because he used to come twice a week for lessons. Yeah. And we were living on St. Philip Street that day. Uh-huh. You knew when, when we lived there. Where were you at the time when we lived on St. Philip?

Well, I was a good boy, but I was gone. Oh, I've been gone. Every time a band came, I was gone. That's why I figured you were so much, uh- Yeah, you see, when I was small, when we lived around, I was playing on the steam and wash it's called, but Lewis Andre was living next to Peter Flair, next to Santa Hans Church. Who? Lewis Andre was a kid that died just for the sites for us in Philadelphia. I remember. He lived across the street from, uh, the boy pals and, um, he was- I can't remember. He was, uh, when he…
